All items are freestanding, with safe equipment clearances and a continuous circulation route through the room.

zones.description: Cardio equipment zone in the northwest portion of the room, with machines aligned near the logical north and west perimeter and facing the studio mirror.
Strength-training zone in the southwest portion, containing the rack, bench, free weights, and accessible weight storage.
Open central studio zone for two yoga practitioners, with mats oriented toward a freestanding mirror and accessories staged at mat edges.
Quiet recovery corner in the northeast with a supportive chair, side table, and foam rollers within easy reach.
Arts-and-crafts work zone in the southeast with a worktable, two stools, easel, task lighting, and accessible freestanding storage.
Unobstructed cross-room route connecting the south-center boundary, central yoga area, and all perimeter activity zones.

global_constraints: Keep every object within the logical room boundary; no physical wall, wall-mounted object, or wall support may be assumed.
Maintain a continuous circulation spine at least 1.0 meter wide from the south-center boundary through the middle of the room and toward every functional zone.
Preserve at least 2.0 meters of unobstructed safety clearance behind the treadmill and approximately 0.6 meters along each side.
Preserve open approach and operating space in front of the power rack, dumbbell rack, storage cabinet, shelving unit, easel, and craft worktable.
Keep the central yoga area free of furniture and equipment other than movable yoga accessories, with approximately 0.6 meters of clearance around each deployed mat.
Separate moving cardio equipment and the strength station from the yoga and recovery activity footprints.
Orient all storage access faces toward open aisles and keep doors, drawers, shelves, and equipment handles reachable.
Arrange tall freestanding objects near logical perimeter zones without relying on attachment to a physical wall.
Keep the recovery and hobby zones outside the treadmill rear-clearance corridor and the power-rack lifting envelope.
